CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_activate_standard_member(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_number text;
  v_type text;
  v_status text;
  v_attempts integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User ID is required';
  END IF;

  -- Prevent concurrent activation.
  PERFORM 1
  FROM auth.users
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User does not exist';
  END IF;

  -- Require a completed $100 payment
  -- for the current subscription billing period.
  -- Payment records must originate from trusted
  -- Square payment verification.
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_standard_subscriptions sub
    JOIN public.gallaspy_subscription_payments pay
      ON pay.subscription_id = sub.id
    WHERE sub.user_id = p_user_id
      AND sub.subscription_status IN ('active', 'canceled')
      AND sub.monthly_amount_cents = 10000
      AND sub.currency = 'USD'
      AND sub.square_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
      AND sub.current_period_start <= now()
      AND sub.current_period_end > now()
      AND pay.payment_status = 'completed'
      AND pay.amount_cents = 10000
      AND pay.currency = 'USD'
      AND pay.billing_period_start = sub.current_period_start
      AND pay.billing_period_end = sub.current_period_end
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Verified current subscription payment required';
  END IF;

  -- Protect Falcon Society membership.
  SELECT membership_type, membership_status
  INTO v_type, v_status
  FROM public.gallaspy_memberships
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

  IF v_type = 'falcon_society' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Falcon Society membership cannot be overwritten';
  END IF;

  -- Protect suspended accounts.
  IF v_status = 'suspended' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Suspended membership requires administrator review';
  END IF;

  -- Retrieve existing membership number.
  SELECT membership_number
  INTO v_number
  FROM public.gallaspy_memberships
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

  -- Generate a unique membership number.
  IF v_number IS NULL THEN
    LOOP
      v_attempts := v_attempts + 1;

      IF v_attempts > 100 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
          'Unable to allocate a unique Standard Membership number';
      END IF;

      v_number :=
        public.gallaspy_next_standard_member_number();

      EXIT WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.gallaspy_memberships
        WHERE membership_number = v_number
      );
    END LOOP;

  ELSIF v_number !~ '^GGC-[0-9]{6,}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Existing Standard Membership number requires administrator review';
  END IF;

  -- Activate Standard Membership.
  INSERT INTO public.gallaspy_memberships (
    user_id,
    membership_number,
    membership_type,
    membership_status,
    approved_at
  )
  VALUES (
    p_user_id,
    v_number,
    'standard',
    'approved',
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (user_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    membership_number = EXCLUDED.membership_number,
    membership_status = 'approved',
    approved_at = COALESCE(
      public.gallaspy_memberships.approved_at,
      now()
    ),
    updated_at = now();

  RETURN v_number;
END;
$function$

definition.parameters: p_user_id uuid, p_agreement_version text, p_agreement_sha256 text, p_rules_version text, p_rules_sha256 text, p_waiver_version text, p_waiver_sha256 text, p_billing_version text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_begin_standard_enrollment_processing_v2(p_user_id uuid, p_attempt_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_attempt public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL OR p_attempt_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  -- Serialize concurrent requests for this user.
  PERFORM 1
  FROM auth.users
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_attempt
  FROM public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts
  WHERE id = p_attempt_id
    AND user_id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND
     OR v_attempt.enrollment_status <> 'reserved'
     OR v_attempt.selected_plan NOT IN ('monthly', 'annual')
  THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_memberships m
    WHERE m.user_id = p_user_id
      AND (
        m.membership_type = 'falcon_society'
        OR m.membership_status IN ('approved', 'suspended')
      )
  ) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_standard_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.user_id = p_user_id
      AND s.square_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
  ) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  -- Signed legal acceptance must belong to this exact attempt.
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_membership_legal_acceptances l
    WHERE l.user_id = p_user_id
      AND l.enrollment_attempt_id = p_attempt_id
      AND l.membership_plan = v_attempt.selected_plan
      AND l.legal_terms_accepted = true
      AND l.electronic_signature_consent = true
      AND length(btrim(l.signed_full_name)) > 0
      AND l.accepted_at IS NOT NULL
  ) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  -- Consent must match the locked enrollment prices.
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_membership_billing_consents b
    WHERE b.user_id = p_user_id
      AND b.enrollment_attempt_id = p_attempt_id
      AND b.membership_plan = v_attempt.selected_plan
      AND b.initiation_fee_cents =
          v_attempt.initiation_fee_cents
      AND b.initial_payment_cents =
          v_attempt.initial_payment_cents
      AND b.renewal_amount_cents =
          v_attempt.renewal_amount_cents
      AND b.renewal_interval =
          v_attempt.renewal_interval
      AND b.currency = 'USD'
      AND b.billing_consent_accepted = true
      AND b.accepted_at IS NOT NULL
  ) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts
  SET enrollment_status = 'processing',
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_attempt_id
    AND user_id = p_user_id
    AND enrollment_status = 'reserved';

  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_claim_standard_enrollment(p_user_id uuid, p_attempt_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_claimed boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL OR p_attempt_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts a
  SET
    enrollment_status = 'processing',
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE a.id = p_attempt_id
    AND a.user_id = p_user_id
    AND a.enrollment_status = 'reserved'
    AND a.square_subscription_id IS NULL

    -- Prevent duplicate Square subscriptions.
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.gallaspy_standard_subscriptions s
      WHERE s.user_id = p_user_id
        AND s.square_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
    )

    -- Protect Falcon Society and existing memberships.
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.gallaspy_memberships gm
      WHERE gm.user_id = p_user_id
        AND (
          gm.membership_type = 'falcon_society'
          OR gm.membership_status IN ('approved', 'suspended')
        )
    );

  v_claimed := FOUND;

  RETURN v_claimed;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_next_standard_member_number()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT 'GGC-' ||
    lpad(
      nextval(
        'public.gallaspy_standard_member_number_seq'::regclass
      )::text,
      6,
      '0'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_protect_enrollment_plan()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- A bound plan and its prices cannot be changed or cleared.
    IF OLD.selected_plan IS NOT NULL
       AND (
           NEW.selected_plan IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.selected_plan
           OR NEW.initiation_fee_cents
               IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.initiation_fee_cents
           OR NEW.initial_payment_cents
               IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.initial_payment_cents
           OR NEW.renewal_amount_cents
               IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.renewal_amount_cents
           OR NEW.renewal_interval
               IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.renewal_interval
       )
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Enrollment plan and pricing cannot be changed';
    END IF;

    -- Initial plan selection is permitted only while reserved.
    IF OLD.selected_plan IS NULL
       AND NEW.selected_plan IS NOT NULL
       AND OLD.enrollment_status <> 'reserved'
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Only reserved enrollment attempts may select a plan';
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_record_membership_acceptance(p_user_id uuid, p_enrollment_attempt_id uuid, p_membership_plan text, p_membership_agreement_version text, p_membership_agreement_sha256 text, p_club_rules_version text, p_club_rules_sha256 text, p_activity_waiver_version text, p_activity_waiver_sha256 text, p_signed_full_name text, p_electronic_signature_consent boolean, p_legal_terms_accepted boolean)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_attempt record;
    v_acceptance_id uuid;
BEGIN
    -- Legal documents have not yet received final approval.
    -- Fail closed until approved-document verification is implemented.
    RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Membership legal acceptance is disabled pending document approval';

    -- The following logic is prepared but cannot execute
    -- while the approval safeguard above remains active.

    SELECT
        user_id,
        selected_plan,
        enrollment_status
    INTO v_attempt
    FROM public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts
    WHERE id = p_enrollment_attempt_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enrollment attempt not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_attempt.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_user_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enrollment owner mismatch';
    END IF;

    IF v_attempt.selected_plan IS DISTINCT FROM p_membership_plan THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Membership plan mismatch';
    END IF;

    IF v_attempt.enrollment_status <> 'reserved' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enrollment is not reserved';
    END IF;

    IF p_electronic_signature_consent IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
       OR p_legal_terms_accepted IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Explicit legal consent is required';
    END IF;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.gallaspy_membership_legal_acceptances
        WHERE enrollment_attempt_id = p_enrollment_attempt_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Legal acceptance already exists';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.gallaspy_membership_legal_acceptances (
        user_id,
        enrollment_attempt_id,
        membership_plan,
        membership_agreement_version,
        membership_agreement_sha256,
        club_rules_version,
        club_rules_sha256,
        activity_waiver_version,
        activity_waiver_sha256,
        signed_full_name,
        electronic_signature_consent,
        legal_terms_accepted
    )
    VALUES (
        p_user_id,
        p_enrollment_attempt_id,
        p_membership_plan,
        p_membership_agreement_version,
        p_membership_agreement_sha256,
        p_club_rules_version,
        p_club_rules_sha256,
        p_activity_waiver_version,
        p_activity_waiver_sha256,
        p_signed_full_name,
        p_electronic_signature_consent,
        p_legal_terms_accepted
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_acceptance_id;

    RETURN v_acceptance_id;
END;
$function$
definition.parameters: p_user_id uuid, p_enrollment_attempt_id uuid, p_membership_plan text, p_membership_agreement_version text, p_membership_agreement_sha256 text, p_club_rules_version text, p_club_rules_sha256 text, p_activity_waiver_version text, p_activity_waiver_sha256 text, p_signed_full_name text, p_electronic_signature_consent boolean, p_legal_terms_accepted boolean

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_record_membership_billing_consent(p_user_id uuid, p_enrollment_attempt_id uuid, p_membership_plan text, p_billing_disclosure_version text, p_billing_consent_accepted boolean)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_attempt record;
    v_consent_id uuid;
BEGIN
    -- SAFETY LOCK:
    -- Do not record real billing consent until the approved
    -- disclosure and authenticated enrollment workflow are ready.
    RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Membership billing consent recording is disabled pending approval';

    SELECT
        user_id,
        selected_plan,
        enrollment_status,
        initiation_fee_cents,
        initial_payment_cents,
        renewal_amount_cents,
        renewal_interval
    INTO v_attempt
    FROM public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts
    WHERE id = p_enrollment_attempt_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enrollment attempt not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_attempt.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_user_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enrollment owner mismatch';
    END IF;

    IF v_attempt.enrollment_status <> 'reserved' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enrollment is not reserved';
    END IF;

    IF v_attempt.selected_plan IS DISTINCT FROM p_membership_plan THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Membership plan mismatch';
    END IF;

    IF p_billing_consent_accepted IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Explicit billing consent required';
    END IF;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.gallaspy_membership_billing_consents
        WHERE enrollment_attempt_id = p_enrollment_attempt_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Billing consent already exists';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.gallaspy_membership_billing_consents (
        user_id,
        enrollment_attempt_id,
        membership_plan,
        initiation_fee_cents,
        initial_payment_cents,
        renewal_amount_cents,
        renewal_interval,
        billing_disclosure_version,
        billing_consent_accepted
    )
    VALUES (
        p_user_id,
        p_enrollment_attempt_id,
        p_membership_plan,
        v_attempt.initiation_fee_cents,
        v_attempt.initial_payment_cents,
        v_attempt.renewal_amount_cents,
        v_attempt.renewal_interval,
        p_billing_disclosure_version,
        p_billing_consent_accepted
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_consent_id;

    RETURN v_consent_id;
END;
$function$
definition.parameters: p_user_id uuid, p_enrollment_attempt_id uuid, p_membership_plan text, p_billing_disclosure_version text, p_billing_consent_accepted boolean

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_record_standard_enrollment_progress(p_user_id uuid, p_attempt_id uuid, p_customer_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_card_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_subscription_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_updated boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL OR p_attempt_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF p_customer_id IS NULL
     AND p_card_id IS NULL
     AND p_subscription_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF (
    p_customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(trim(p_customer_id), '') IS NULL
  ) OR (
    p_card_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(trim(p_card_id), '') IS NULL
  ) OR (
    p_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(trim(p_subscription_id), '') IS NULL
  ) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts a
  SET
    square_customer_id =
      COALESCE(p_customer_id, a.square_customer_id),
    square_card_id =
      COALESCE(p_card_id, a.square_card_id),
    square_subscription_id =
      COALESCE(p_subscription_id, a.square_subscription_id),
    enrollment_status =
      CASE
        WHEN p_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
          THEN 'subscription_created'
        ELSE a.enrollment_status
      END,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE a.id = p_attempt_id
    AND a.user_id = p_user_id
    AND a.enrollment_status = 'processing'

    -- Never overwrite an existing Square identifier.
    AND (
      p_customer_id IS NULL
      OR a.square_customer_id IS NULL
      OR a.square_customer_id = p_customer_id
    )
    AND (
      p_card_id IS NULL
      OR a.square_card_id IS NULL
      OR a.square_card_id = p_card_id
    )
    AND (
      p_subscription_id IS NULL
      OR a.square_subscription_id IS NULL
      OR a.square_subscription_id = p_subscription_id
    )

    -- A card must have an associated customer.
    AND (
      p_card_id IS NULL
      OR p_customer_id IS NOT NULL
      OR a.square_customer_id IS NOT NULL
    )

    -- A subscription must have both a customer and card.
    AND (
      p_subscription_id IS NULL
      OR (
        COALESCE(p_customer_id, a.square_customer_id)
          IS NOT NULL
        AND COALESCE(p_card_id, a.square_card_id)
          IS NOT NULL
      )
    );

  v_updated := FOUND;

  RETURN v_updated;
END;
$function$
definition.parameters: p_user_id uuid, p_attempt_id uuid, p_customer_id text, p_card_id text, p_subscription_id text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_record_verified_dues_v2(p_user_id uuid, p_square_subscription_id text, p_square_payment_id text, p_square_invoice_id text, p_amount_cents integer, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_sub public.gallaspy_standard_subscriptions%ROWTYPE;
  v_existing public.gallaspy_subscription_payments%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL
    OR p_square_subscription_id IS NULL
    OR p_square_payment_id IS NULL
    OR p_square_invoice_id IS NULL
    OR p_period_start IS NULL
    OR p_period_end IS NULL
    OR p_period_start > now()
    OR p_period_end <= now()
    OR p_period_start >= p_period_end
    OR p_square_subscription_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    OR p_square_payment_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    OR p_square_invoice_id !~ '^inv:[A-Za-z0-9_:-]{1,251}$'
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid verified dues identity or billing period';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_sub
  FROM public.gallaspy_standard_subscriptions
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    AND square_subscription_id = p_square_subscription_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Linked subscription required';
  END IF;

  IF v_sub.subscription_status NOT IN (
      'pending', 'active', 'canceled'
    )
    OR v_sub.currency <> 'USD'
    OR v_sub.current_period_start IS DISTINCT FROM p_period_start
    OR v_sub.current_period_end IS DISTINCT FROM p_period_end
    OR NOT (
      (
        v_sub.membership_plan = 'monthly'
        AND v_sub.renewal_amount_cents = 10000
        AND v_sub.renewal_interval = 'monthly'
        AND p_amount_cents = 10000
      )
      OR
      (
        v_sub.membership_plan = 'annual'
        AND v_sub.renewal_amount_cents = 100000
        AND v_sub.renewal_interval = 'annual'
        AND p_amount_cents = 100000
      )
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Subscription or dues amount mismatch';
  END IF;

  -- Locking the subscription serializes compliant ledger writers.
  -- Never silently credit a second payment for one period.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_subscription_payments p
    WHERE p.subscription_id = v_sub.id
      AND p.billing_period_start = p_period_start
      AND p.billing_period_end = p_period_end
      AND p.square_payment_id <> p_square_payment_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Billing period already has a different payment';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_subscription_payments p
    WHERE p.square_invoice_id = p_square_invoice_id
      AND p.square_payment_id <> p_square_payment_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invoice already linked to a different payment';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_existing
  FROM public.gallaspy_subscription_payments
  WHERE square_payment_id = p_square_payment_id;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_existing.subscription_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_sub.id
      OR v_existing.square_invoice_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_square_invoice_id
      OR v_existing.billing_period_start IS DISTINCT FROM p_period_start
      OR v_existing.billing_period_end IS DISTINCT FROM p_period_end
      OR v_existing.amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM p_amount_cents
      OR v_existing.currency <> 'USD'
      OR v_existing.payment_status <> 'completed'
      OR v_existing.refunded_amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 0
      OR v_existing.verified_at IS NULL
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Existing payment requires reconciliation';
    END IF;

    RETURN 'duplicate';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.gallaspy_subscription_payments (
    subscription_id,
    square_payment_id,
    square_invoice_id,
    billing_period_start,
    billing_period_end,
    amount_cents,
    currency,
    payment_status,
    paid_at,
    refunded_amount_cents,
    verified_at
  )
  VALUES (
    v_sub.id,
    p_square_payment_id,
    p_square_invoice_id,
    p_period_start,
    p_period_end,
    p_amount_cents,
    'USD',
    'completed',
    now(),
    0,
    now()
  );

  RETURN 'recorded';
END;
$function$
definition.parameters: p_user_id uuid, p_square_subscription_id text, p_square_payment_id text, p_square_invoice_id text, p_amount_cents integer, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_record_verified_dues_v3(p_user_id uuid, p_square_subscription_id text, p_square_payment_id text, p_square_invoice_id text, p_amount_cents integer, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone, p_paid_at timestamp with time zone, p_verified_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_sub public.gallaspy_standard_subscriptions%ROWTYPE;
  v_existing public.gallaspy_subscription_payments%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL
    OR p_square_subscription_id IS NULL
    OR p_square_payment_id IS NULL
    OR p_square_invoice_id IS NULL
    OR p_amount_cents IS NULL
    OR p_period_start IS NULL
    OR p_period_end IS NULL
    OR p_paid_at IS NULL
    OR p_verified_at IS NULL
    OR p_period_start >= p_period_end
    OR p_period_start > now()
    OR p_period_end <= now()
    OR p_paid_at < p_period_start
    OR p_paid_at >= p_period_end
    OR p_paid_at > now()
    OR p_verified_at < p_paid_at
    OR p_verified_at > now()
    OR p_square_subscription_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    OR p_square_payment_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    OR p_square_invoice_id !~ '^inv:[A-Za-z0-9_:-]{1,251}$'
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid verified payment evidence';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_sub
  FROM public.gallaspy_standard_subscriptions
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    AND square_subscription_id = p_square_subscription_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Linked subscription required';
  END IF;

  IF v_sub.subscription_status NOT IN (
    'pending', 'active', 'canceled'
  )
    OR v_sub.currency <> 'USD'
    OR v_sub.current_period_start IS DISTINCT FROM p_period_start
    OR v_sub.current_period_end IS DISTINCT FROM p_period_end
    OR NOT (
      (
        v_sub.membership_plan = 'monthly'
        AND v_sub.renewal_amount_cents = 10000
        AND v_sub.renewal_interval = 'monthly'
        AND p_amount_cents = 10000
      )
      OR
      (
        v_sub.membership_plan = 'annual'
        AND v_sub.renewal_amount_cents = 100000
        AND v_sub.renewal_interval = 'annual'
        AND p_amount_cents = 100000
      )
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Subscription pricing or period mismatch';
  END IF;

  -- Reject another payment assigned to the same period.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_subscription_payments p
    WHERE p.subscription_id = v_sub.id
      AND p.billing_period_start = p_period_start
      AND p.billing_period_end = p_period_end
      AND p.square_payment_id <> p_square_payment_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Billing period has another payment';
  END IF;

  -- Reject invoice reuse with a different Square payment.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_subscription_payments p
    WHERE p.square_invoice_id = p_square_invoice_id
      AND p.square_payment_id <> p_square_payment_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invoice has another payment';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_existing
  FROM public.gallaspy_subscription_payments
  WHERE square_payment_id = p_square_payment_id;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_existing.subscription_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_sub.id
      OR v_existing.square_invoice_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_square_invoice_id
      OR v_existing.billing_period_start IS DISTINCT FROM p_period_start
      OR v_existing.billing_period_end IS DISTINCT FROM p_period_end
      OR v_existing.amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM p_amount_cents
      OR v_existing.currency <> 'USD'
      OR v_existing.payment_status <> 'completed'
      OR v_existing.refunded_amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 0
      OR v_existing.paid_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_paid_at
      OR v_existing.verified_at IS NULL
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Existing payment requires reconciliation';
    END IF;

    RETURN 'duplicate';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.gallaspy_subscription_payments (
    subscription_id,
    square_payment_id,
    square_invoice_id,
    billing_period_start,
    billing_period_end,
    amount_cents,
    currency,
    payment_status,
    paid_at,
    refunded_amount_cents,
    verified_at
  )
  VALUES (
    v_sub.id,
    p_square_payment_id,
    p_square_invoice_id,
    p_period_start,
    p_period_end,
    p_amount_cents,
    'USD',
    'completed',
    p_paid_at,
    0,
    p_verified_at
  );

  RETURN 'recorded';
END;
$function$
definition.parameters: p_user_id uuid, p_square_subscription_id text, p_square_payment_id text, p_square_invoice_id text, p_amount_cents integer, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone, p_paid_at timestamp with time zone, p_verified_at timestamp with time zone

definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_record_verified_initiation_v3(p_user_id uuid, p_enrollment_attempt_id uuid, p_square_payment_id text, p_square_customer_id text, p_square_reference_id uuid, p_paid_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_attempt public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts%ROWTYPE;
  v_payment public.gallaspy_membership_initiation_payments%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN

  -- Require complete, well-formed verification evidence.
  IF p_user_id IS NULL
     OR p_enrollment_attempt_id IS NULL
     OR p_square_reference_id IS NULL
     OR p_square_reference_id IS DISTINCT FROM
        p_enrollment_attempt_id
     OR p_square_payment_id IS NULL
     OR p_square_payment_id !~
        '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,255}$'
     OR p_square_customer_id IS NULL
     OR p_square_customer_id !~
        '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,255}$'
     OR p_paid_at IS NULL
     OR p_paid_at > now()
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Invalid verified initiation evidence';
  END IF;

  -- Serialize payment operations for this user.
  PERFORM 1
  FROM auth.users
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enrollment user not found';
  END IF;

  -- Lock the actual monthly enrollment attempt.
  SELECT *
  INTO v_attempt
  FROM public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts
  WHERE id = p_enrollment_attempt_id
    AND user_id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND
     OR v_attempt.selected_plan IS DISTINCT FROM 'monthly'
     OR v_attempt.initiation_fee_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 25000
     OR v_attempt.initial_payment_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 35000
     OR v_attempt.renewal_amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 10000
     OR v_attempt.renewal_interval IS DISTINCT FROM 'monthly'
     OR v_attempt.idempotency_key IS NULL
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Monthly enrollment identity or pricing mismatch';
  END IF;

  -- A failed or review-required attempt cannot be credited.
  IF v_attempt.enrollment_status IN (
    'failed',
    'requires_review'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Enrollment requires administrative review';
  END IF;

  -- Lock the existing payment reservation.
  -- This RPC never creates a payment reservation.
  SELECT *
  INTO v_payment
  FROM public.gallaspy_membership_initiation_payments
  WHERE enrollment_attempt_id = p_enrollment_attempt_id
    AND user_id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND
     OR v_payment.membership_plan IS DISTINCT FROM 'monthly'
     OR v_payment.idempotency_key
        IS DISTINCT FROM v_attempt.idempotency_key
     OR v_payment.amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 25000
     OR v_payment.currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'USD'
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Existing initiation reservation required';
  END IF;

  -- Safe retry: an already completed payment must match
  -- the exact original evidence and remain unrefunded.
  IF v_payment.payment_status = 'completed' THEN
    IF v_payment.square_payment_id
         IS DISTINCT FROM p_square_payment_id
       OR v_payment.square_customer_id
         IS DISTINCT FROM p_square_customer_id
       OR v_payment.paid_at
         IS DISTINCT FROM p_paid_at
       OR v_payment.refunded_amount_cents
         IS DISTINCT FROM 0
       OR v_payment.verified_at IS NULL
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Conflicting completed initiation payment';
    END IF;

    RETURN 'already_recorded';
  END IF;

  IF v_payment.payment_status NOT IN (
    'reserved',
    'processing'
  )
  OR v_attempt.enrollment_status NOT IN (
    'reserved',
    'processing',
    'subscription_created'
  )
  OR v_payment.square_payment_id IS NOT NULL
  OR v_payment.verified_at IS NOT NULL
  OR v_payment.paid_at IS NOT NULL
  OR v_payment.refunded_amount_cents
       IS DISTINCT FROM NULL
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Initiation reservation cannot be completed';
  END IF;

  -- Evidence must not predate the reservation.
  IF p_paid_at < v_payment.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Square payment predates initiation reservation';
  END IF;

  -- Exactly one transition to completed.
  UPDATE public.gallaspy_membership_initiation_payments
  SET
    payment_status = 'completed',
    square_payment_id = p_square_payment_id,
    square_customer_id = p_square_customer_id,
    refunded_amount_cents = 0,
    paid_at = p_paid_at,
    verified_at = clock_timestamp(),
    updated_at = clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id = v_payment.id
    AND payment_status IN ('reserved', 'processing');

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Initiation payment transition failed';
  END IF;

  RETURN 'recorded';
END;
$function$
definition.parameters: p_user_id uuid, p_enrollment_attempt_id uuid, p_square_payment_id text, p_square_customer_id text, p_square_reference_id uuid, p_paid_at timestamp with time zone

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_reserve_initiation_payment(p_user_id uuid, p_enrollment_attempt_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            v_attempt record;
            v_payment record;
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                user_id,
                selected_plan,
                enrollment_status,
                initiation_fee_cents,
                initial_payment_cents,
                renewal_amount_cents,
                renewal_interval,
                idempotency_key
            INTO v_attempt
            FROM public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts
            WHERE id = p_enrollment_attempt_id
            FOR UPDATE;

            IF NOT FOUND THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enrollment attempt not found';
            END IF;

            IF v_attempt.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_user_id
               OR v_attempt.selected_plan IS DISTINCT FROM 'monthly'
               OR v_attempt.enrollment_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'reserved'
               OR v_attempt.initiation_fee_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 25000
               OR v_attempt.initial_payment_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 35000
               OR v_attempt.renewal_amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 10000
               OR v_attempt.renewal_interval IS DISTINCT FROM 'monthly'
               OR v_attempt.idempotency_key IS NULL
            THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION
                    'Enrollment does not qualify for initiation reservation';
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO public.gallaspy_membership_initiation_payments (
                user_id,
                enrollment_attempt_id,
                membership_plan,
                idempotency_key,
                amount_cents,
                currency,
                payment_status
            )
            VALUES (
                p_user_id,
                p_enrollment_attempt_id,
                'monthly',
                v_attempt.idempotency_key,
                25000,
                'USD',
                'reserved'
            )
            ON CONFLICT (enrollment_attempt_id) DO NOTHING;

            SELECT *
            INTO v_payment
            FROM public.gallaspy_membership_initiation_payments
            WHERE enrollment_attempt_id = p_enrollment_attempt_id;

            IF NOT FOUND
               OR v_payment.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_user_id
               OR v_payment.membership_plan IS DISTINCT FROM 'monthly'
               OR v_payment.idempotency_key
                    IS DISTINCT FROM v_attempt.idempotency_key
               OR v_payment.amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 25000
               OR v_payment.currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'USD'
               OR v_payment.payment_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'reserved'
               OR v_payment.square_payment_id IS NOT NULL
               OR v_payment.verified_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION
                    'Initiation reservation conflict requires review';
            END IF;

            RETURN v_payment.id;
        END;
        $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gallaspy_reserve_standard_enrollment(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid, idempotency_key uuid, enrollment_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User ID is required';
  END IF;

  -- Prevent concurrent enrollment requests.
  PERFORM 1
  FROM auth.users
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'User does not exist';
  END IF;

  -- Protect Falcon Society, active, and suspended members.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_memberships m
    WHERE m.user_id = p_user_id
      AND (
        m.membership_type = 'falcon_society'
        OR m.membership_status IN ('approved', 'suspended')
      )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Existing membership requires review before enrollment';
  END IF;

  -- Prevent duplicate Square subscriptions.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.gallaspy_standard_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.user_id = p_user_id
      AND s.square_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Existing subscription requires review before enrollment';
  END IF;

  -- Create or reuse enrollment attempt.
  INSERT INTO public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts (
    user_id
  )
  VALUES (
    p_user_id
  )
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.idempotency_key,
    a.enrollment_status
  FROM public.gallaspy_standard_enrollment_attempts a
  WHERE a.user_id = p_user_id;
END;
$function$

constraints.name: gallaspy_subscription_period_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_period_start IS NULL) OR (current_period_end IS NULL) OR (current_period_end > current_period_start)))

constraints.name: gallaspy_subscription_plan_v2_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((membership_plan = 'monthly'::text) AND (renewal_amount_cents = 10000) AND (renewal_interval = 'monthly'::text) AND (monthly_amount_cents = 10000)) OR ((membership_plan = 'annual'::text) AND (renewal_amount_cents = 100000) AND (renewal_interval = 'annual'::text) AND (monthly_amount_cents IS NULL))))

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX gallaspy_subscription_payments_pkey ON public.gallaspy_subscription_payments USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX gallaspy_subscription_payments_square_payment_id_key ON public.gallaspy_subscription_payments USING btree (square_payment_id)
CREATE INDEX gallaspy_subscription_payments_invoice_idx ON public.gallaspy_subscription_payments USING btree (square_invoice_id) WHERE (square_invoice_id IS NOT NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX gallaspy_standard_payment_one_per_period_idx ON public.gallaspy_subscription_payments USING btree (subscription_id, billing_period_start, billing_period_end) WHERE ((billing_period_start IS NOT NULL) AND (billing_period_end IS NOT NULL))

policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM gallaspy_standard_subscriptions s
  WHERE ((s.id = gallaspy_subscription_payments.subscription_id) AND (s.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))
policies.policyname: Members can read their own subscription payments

constraints.name: gallaspy_dues_refund_amount_v2_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((refunded_amount_cents IS NULL) OR ((refunded_amount_cents >= 0) AND (refunded_amount_cents <= amount_cents))))

constraints.name: gallaspy_payment_billing_period_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((billing_period_start IS NULL) OR (billing_period_end IS NULL) OR (billing_period_end > billing_period_start)))
